mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.2%) signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.2% (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment rates (UNRATE > 10.0) signal a weak labor market, indicating economic distress and reduced consumer spending, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of triggered instances (UNRATE > 10.0) with t-test p-value < 0.05 against baseline.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate contracting consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (both HOUST and RSAFS declining) fails to predict negative returns in 60% or more of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO < 95) signals reduced manufacturing output, indicating economic slowdown, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of periods when INDPRO < 95 (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) reflects strong consumer demand for housing, boosting economic activity and predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 220 indicates elevated inflation, prompting potential monetary tightening, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 220) with t-test p-value < 0.05 against baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing output, indicating economic strength, which predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.2) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 10.0) signal aggressive monetary easing to combat recession, which predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS < 0.2 and UNRATE > 10.0) fails to predict positive returns in 60% or more of cases (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).
